title: marketing
text:
marketing

maggie (Marketing): Kicking off the Zenith Systems customer story — they signed off on the high-level narrative but we need a final quote and legal sign-off. Who can own the interview + quote collection this week?

sam (Content): I can run the interview. Prefer Wed morning — need 30 mins. Can someone draft the questions and the quote seed?

jordan (Product): I can do the technical questions. Important we capture the latency/cost improvements and the Dedicated deployment details.

maggie (Marketing): Great. Diego, can you re-introduce us to the Zenith contact so we can schedule and get quote approvals?

diego (Sales): Yep — emailed their CSM just now and cc'd the Zenith PM. I put a calendar poll for Wed/Thu. Sharing proposed quote below for their approval.

diego (Sales): "With Redwood Dedicated, we cut inference costs by ~45% and saw p95 latency halve — we could safely double throughput without infra changes." — placeholder, pls redline.

linda (Legal): Quick checklist from legal: 1) No attribution without customer approval, 2) No confidential metrics to be published, 3) If they request anonymity we need an NDA addendum. Please send the exact quote to the customer with the approval checkbox.

sam (Content): Draft email to send to Zenith (copy):
```
Hi <Name>,
Thanks again for doing the customer story. Below is the proposed quote for your review. Reply with any edits or "Approved" and we’ll publish.

Proposed quote: "Redwood Dedicated reduced our per-request cost by ~45% and improved tail latency significantly, letting us support more users during peak hours."

Best,
Sam
```

maggie (Marketing): Linda — can you confirm the minimal legal phrasing we should include in that email? Also are there any redlines we should pre-emptively avoid? :lock:

linda (Legal): Add a short approval line: "I approve the quote above for public use by Redwood Inference." Also, remove any exact dollar amounts or internal customer KPIs unless explicitly cleared. If they want anonymity, use: "a leading fintech company" and send NDA.

jordan (Product): For technical accuracy, swap "tail latency" -> "p95 latency" and add "on our c5x/amp deployment" only if the customer confirms the infra tag.

sam (Content): Noted — I’ll update the draft and send once Diego confirms scheduling.

diego (Sales): Zenith replied — preferring Thu 10am PT. They asked for the earlier quote to be softened (no % numbers). I proposed the exact quote but a non-numeric version: "Redwood Dedicated significantly reduced our inference costs and improved latency, enabling higher throughput." They asked for a day to confirm.

maggie (Marketing): Ok — update: once they approve we need ops to add inbound lead routing from the case-study landing page to Sales SDR queue + tag the account as "case-study:zenith" in CRM. ops-bot, can you drop the routing rule snippet?

ops-bot: Proposed routing rule (for ops team):
```
route: /case-studies/zenith -> sales.sdr.queue
add_tag: crm.account.tags += ["case-study:zenith"]
notify: #sales-inbound (webhook)
```

ops-bot: Also setting TTL for demo requests from that page to 90 days.

linda (Legal): After they approve the quote, send a one-line approval via email that we can store. Legal will keep a copy for audit.

sam (Content): I'll send the email draft in ~30 mins; will ping here once it's out.

maggie (Marketing): Thanks team. Once quote is approved we schedule a fast design pass for the case layout and the bench narrative. Also thinking a short webinar invite tied to the story — Diego, can you flag any high-quality leads from Zenith's lists for co-marketing?

diego (Sales): Will do — flagging co-marketing leads as "co-marketing:zenith" in CRM after we get permission.

maggie (Marketing): Perfect. Closing loop: Sam = interview + quote send, Jordan = tech Qs, Linda = legal sign-off, Diego = customer coordination + lead ops, Maggie = launch owner. Will reconvene after approval. :thumbsup:
